en: Industry Survey: The Present and Future of Intelligent Robotics
zh: 行业调查：智能机器人的现状与未来

excerpts.zh: 机器人进入日常生活时，需要同时考虑技术与社会影响。
excerpts.en: Robots entering everyday life raise both technical and social questions.

excerpts.zh: 养老陪伴和日常照料，让机器人设计与人的生活需求直接相遇。
excerpts.en: Companionship and everyday care connect robot design directly with human needs.

excerpts.zh: 不同文化对机器人参与情感交互的接受程度可能不同。
excerpts.en: Acceptance of emotional interaction with robots may vary across cultures.

excerpts.zh: 理解人的情感和回应方式，是人机交互的一部分。
excerpts.en: Understanding and responding to human emotion is part of human–robot interaction.

excerpts.zh: 高能耗是机器人走向更广泛应用时需要面对的约束。
excerpts.en: Energy consumption constrains the broader use of robotics.

excerpts.zh: 讨论机器人发展，也需要讨论伦理、责任与社会效益。
excerpts.en: Discussing robotics also means considering ethics, responsibility and social benefit.
